name: A Dose of Kindness
description: Nadia needs tablets delivered to residents who cannot easily reach the clinic. Their conflicting reactions make her question whether the treatment is helping.
offerText: Could you help me deliver medicine?

stages.description: Receive two white tablets from Nadia.
Deliver one white tablet to Elena Jovanovic.
Offer Dusan Markovic a white tablet.
Return to Nadia after speaking to Elena and Dusan. Tell Nadia how Elena and Dusan responded to the prescribed tablets.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Nadia tests whether government tablets are reaching residents; Elena trusts them while Dusan doubts them.
implementationNotes: Keep delivery counts and recipients unchanged.
On report set hospital_tablet_discrepancy; do not declare pills proven ineffective.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
